title: Picture Story · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Picture Story · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Give the lead paper and pencil. The lead draws three simple panels showing a beginning, a change and an ending; the group describes the story. The group identifies the intended sequence of events. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Picture Story, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group identifies the intended sequence of events.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group identifies the intended sequence of events.
